    centroids = kmeans.cluster_centers_

        centroids[:, 1],
        c="red",
        marker="X",
        s=200,
        edgecolors="black",
        linewidths=1,
        label="Centroids",

    plt.title("KMeans Clustering of Random 2D Points")
    plt.xlabel("X")
    plt.ylabel("Y")
    plt.xlim(0, RANGE)
    plt.ylim(0, RANGE)
    plt.legend()
